scope: parking (parking, stopping and standing a vehicle, and where each is not allowed)

vocabulary.definition: The operator: a person who drives or has physical control of a vehicle.
Where stopping is prohibited, to halt a vehicle, occupied or unoccupied, even for a moment.
To halt an occupied or unoccupied vehicle, other than for a short time while picking up or letting off passengers.
To stand an occupied or unoccupied vehicle, other than for a short time while loading or unloading goods or passengers.
The part of a highway, other than the berm or shoulder, that is improved, designed, or ordinarily used for vehicular travel.
The width between the boundary lines of a publicly maintained way, any part of which is open to the public for vehicular travel.
The part of a street between the curb or the side of the roadway and the property line that is meant for pedestrian use.
The area where two or more highways join or cross, within the extensions of their lateral curb lines or boundary lines.
Part of a roadway at an intersection within the extensions of the sidewalk lines, or any part of a roadway marked for pedestrian crossing by lines or other markings.
An area or space officially set apart in a roadway for pedestrians only and marked or indicated by adequate signs as plainly visible at all times.
A sign, signal, marking, or device placed or erected by a public body or officer having jurisdiction to regulate, warn, or guide traffic.

A territory next to a highway that is built up with business or residential buildings as defined in the Texas Transportation Code, generally with buildings in use along at least 300 feet of the highway.
Left with no licensed driver present in or immediately beside the vehicle.
A parking space designated for persons with disabilities by a sign showing the International Symbol of Access.
The striped space beside a DISABLED PARKING SPACE that gives room for entering and leaving a vehicle, including by wheelchair.
A disabled parking placard, or a specialty license plate for persons with disabilities or disabled veterans, issued under Texas law.
A fire department, police, ambulance, or other vehicle authorized under Texas law as an emergency vehicle.

rules.title: No double parking
rules.when: a vehicle is stopped or parked at the edge or curb of a street
rules.action: STOP, STAND, or PARK on the ROADWAY side of that vehicle
rules.unless: avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN a vehicle is stopped or parked at the edge or curb of a street, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND, or PARK on the ROADWAY side of that vehicle, UNLESS avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE.
rules.note: Transportation Code 545.302(a)(1). Fine range is the general penalty of 545/542.401; local ordinances may set parking fines.

rules.title: Not on a sidewalk
rules.when: the vehicle is on a SIDEWALK
rules.action: STOP, STAND, or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is on a SIDEWALK, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND, or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE.

rules.title: Not in an intersection
rules.when: the vehicle is in an INTERSECTION
rules.action: STOP, STAND, or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is in an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND, or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE.

rules.title: Not on a crosswalk
rules.when: the vehicle is on a CROSSWALK
rules.action: STOP, STAND, or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is on a CROSSWALK, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND, or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE.

rules.title: Not at a safety zone
rules.when: the vehicle is between a SAFETY ZONE and the adjacent curb OR within 30 feet of a place on the curb immediately opposite the ends of a SAFETY ZONE
rules.action: STOP, STAND, or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: a local authority has set a different length by sign or marking OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is between a SAFETY ZONE and the adjacent curb OR within 30 feet of a place on the curb immediately opposite the ends of a SAFETY ZONE, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND, or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS a local authority has set a different length by sign or marking OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE.
rules.note: Transportation Code 545.302(a)(5); the governing body may designate a different length.

rules.title: Not beside an excavation or obstruction
rules.when: the vehicle is alongside or opposite a street excavation or obstruction AND stopping there would obstruct traffic
rules.action: STOP, STAND, or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is alongside or opposite a street excavation or obstruction AND stopping there would obstruct traffic, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND, or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE.

rules.title: Not on a bridge or in a tunnel
rules.when: the vehicle is on a bridge or other elevated structure on a HIGHWAY OR in a HIGHWAY tunnel
rules.action: STOP, STAND, or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is on a bridge or other elevated structure on a HIGHWAY OR in a HIGHWAY tunnel, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND, or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE.

rules.title: Not on a railroad track
rules.when: the vehicle is on a railroad track
rules.action: STOP, STAND, or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is on a railroad track, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND, or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE.

rules.title: No Stopping sign
rules.when: an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE prohibits stopping at the place
rules.action: STOP, STAND, or PARK the vehicle there
rules.unless: avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the directions of a police officer
rules.statement: WHEN an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE prohibits stopping at the place, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND, or PARK the vehicle there, UNLESS avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the directions of a police officer.
rules.note: Transportation Code 545.302(a). Fire lanes are typically marked by signs or red curbs under local ordinance or fire code; their fines are set locally.

rules.title: Not in front of a driveway
rules.when: the vehicle is in front of a public or private driveway
rules.action: STAND or PARK the vehicle, occupied or unoccupied
rules.unless: the DRIVER is momentarily picking up or letting off a passenger OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is in front of a public or private driveway, the DRIVER MUST NOT STAND or PARK the vehicle, occupied or unoccupied, UNLESS the DRIVER is momentarily picking up or letting off a passenger OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE.

rules.title: 15 feet from a fire hydrant
rules.when: the vehicle is within 15 feet of a fire hydrant
rules.action: STAND or PARK the vehicle, occupied or unoccupied
rules.unless: the DRIVER is momentarily picking up or letting off a passenger OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is within 15 feet of a fire hydrant, the DRIVER MUST NOT STAND or PARK the vehicle, occupied or unoccupied, UNLESS the DRIVER is momentarily picking up or letting off a passenger OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE.

rules.title: 20 feet from a crosswalk at an intersection
rules.when: the vehicle is within 20 feet of a CROSSWALK at an INTERSECTION
rules.action: STAND or PARK the vehicle, occupied or unoccupied
rules.unless: the DRIVER is momentarily picking up or letting off a passenger OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is within 20 feet of a CROSSWALK at an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MUST NOT STAND or PARK the vehicle, occupied or unoccupied, UNLESS the DRIVER is momentarily picking up or letting off a passenger OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE.

rules.title: 30 feet before a signal or stop/yield sign
rules.when: the vehicle is within 30 feet on the approach to a flashing signal, stop sign, yield sign, or traffic-control signal located at the side of a ROADWAY
rules.action: STAND or PARK the vehicle, occupied or unoccupied
rules.unless: the DRIVER is momentarily picking up or letting off a passenger OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is within 30 feet on the approach to a flashing signal, stop sign, yield sign, or traffic-control signal located at the side of a ROADWAY, the DRIVER MUST NOT STAND or PARK the vehicle, occupied or unoccupied, UNLESS the DRIVER is momentarily picking up or letting off a passenger OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE.

rules.title: 20 feet from a fire station driveway
rules.when: the vehicle is within 20 feet of the driveway entrance to a fire station
rules.action: STAND or PARK the vehicle, occupied or unoccupied
rules.unless: the DRIVER is momentarily picking up or letting off a passenger OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is within 20 feet of the driveway entrance to a fire station, the DRIVER MUST NOT STAND or PARK the vehicle, occupied or unoccupied, UNLESS the DRIVER is momentarily picking up or letting off a passenger OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE.

rules.title: 75 feet opposite a signed fire station entrance
rules.when: the vehicle is on the side of the street opposite the entrance to a fire station AND within 75 feet of that entrance AND the entrance is properly marked with a sign
rules.action: STAND or PARK the vehicle, occupied or unoccupied
rules.unless: the DRIVER is momentarily picking up or letting off a passenger OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is on the side of the street opposite the entrance to a fire station AND within 75 feet of that entrance AND the entrance is properly marked with a sign, the DRIVER MUST NOT STAND or PARK the vehicle, occupied or unoccupied, UNLESS the DRIVER is momentarily picking up or letting off a passenger OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE.

rules.title: No Standing sign
rules.when: an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE prohibits standing at the place
rules.action: STAND or PARK the vehicle there, occupied or unoccupied
rules.unless: the DRIVER is momentarily picking up or letting off a passenger OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the directions of a police officer
rules.statement: WHEN an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE prohibits standing at the place, the DRIVER MUST NOT STAND or PARK the vehicle there, occupied or unoccupied, UNLESS the DRIVER is momentarily picking up or letting off a passenger OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the directions of a police officer.

rules.title: 50 feet from a railroad crossing
rules.when: the vehicle is within 50 feet of the nearest rail of a railroad crossing
rules.action: PARK the vehicle, occupied or unoccupied
rules.unless: the DRIVER is temporarily loading or unloading merchandise or passengers OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is within 50 feet of the nearest rail of a railroad crossing, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK the vehicle, occupied or unoccupied, UNLESS the DRIVER is temporarily loading or unloading merchandise or passengers OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the law or the directions of a police officer or OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE.

rules.title: No Parking sign
rules.when: an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE prohibits parking at the place
rules.action: PARK the vehicle there, occupied or unoccupied
rules.unless: the DRIVER is temporarily loading or unloading merchandise or passengers OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the directions of a police officer
rules.statement: WHEN an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE prohibits parking at the place, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK the vehicle there, occupied or unoccupied, UNLESS the DRIVER is temporarily loading or unloading merchandise or passengers OR avoiding conflict with other traffic is necessary OR the DRIVER is complying with the directions of a police officer.
rules.note: Transportation Code 545.302(c)(2). Time limits, meters and fire lanes are set by local ordinance and shown by signs or curb markings; Texas has no statewide curb-colour code.

rules.title: Moving another's vehicle
rules.when: moving a vehicle that is not lawfully under the person's control
rules.action: move it into an area where stopping, standing, or parking is prohibited OR away from a curb to a distance that is unlawful
rules.statement: WHEN moving a vehicle that is not lawfully under the person's control, the person MUST NOT move it into an area where stopping, standing, or parking is prohibited OR away from a curb to a distance that is unlawful.

rules.title: Emergency vehicles exempt
rules.actor: DRIVER of an AUTHORIZED EMERGENCY VEHICLE
rules.when: responding to an emergency call OR pursuing a suspected violator OR responding to a fire alarm
rules.action: PARK or STAND the vehicle irrespective of the stopping, standing and parking prohibitions
rules.statement: WHEN responding to an emergency call OR pursuing a suspected violator OR responding to a fire alarm, the DRIVER of an AUTHORIZED EMERGENCY VEHICLE MAY PARK or STAND the vehicle irrespective of the stopping, standing and parking prohibitions.
rules.note: Transportation Code 546.001; the driver must still drive with appropriate regard for the safety of all persons, and warning signals requirements apply.

rules.title: Off the main traveled part outside districts
rules.when: outside a BUSINESS OR RESIDENCE DISTRICT AND it is practicable to stop, park, or leave the vehicle off the main traveled part of the HIGHWAY
rules.action: STOP, PARK, or leave standing the vehicle, attended or UNATTENDED, on the main traveled part of the HIGHWAY
rules.unless: the vehicle is disabled so that it is impossible to avoid stopping and temporarily leaving it there
rules.statement: WHEN outside a BUSINESS OR RESIDENCE DISTRICT AND it is practicable to stop, park, or leave the vehicle off the main traveled part of the HIGHWAY, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, PARK, or leave standing the vehicle, attended or UNATTENDED, on the main traveled part of the HIGHWAY, UNLESS the vehicle is disabled so that it is impossible to avoid stopping and temporarily leaving it there.

vague_terms.explanation: not defined by lane or width

rules.title: Clear width and 200-foot view
rules.when: stopping, parking, or leaving standing a vehicle on a HIGHWAY outside a BUSINESS OR RESIDENCE DISTRICT
rules.action: leave a clear width of HIGHWAY opposite the vehicle for other vehicles to pass AND leave the vehicle in clear view from a distance of 200 feet in each direction
rules.unless: the vehicle is disabled so that it is impossible to avoid stopping and temporarily leaving it there
rules.statement: WHEN stopping, parking, or leaving standing a vehicle on a HIGHWAY outside a BUSINESS OR RESIDENCE DISTRICT, the DRIVER MUST leave a clear width of HIGHWAY opposite the vehicle for other vehicles to pass AND leave the vehicle in clear view from a distance of 200 feet in each direction, UNLESS the vehicle is disabled so that it is impossible to avoid stopping and temporarily leaving it there.

rules.title: Disabled vehicle off the road with hazard lamps
rules.when: the vehicle breaks down on a HIGHWAY
rules.action: move the vehicle as far off the ROADWAY as possible AND turn on the hazard warning lamps
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle breaks down on a HIGHWAY, the DRIVER SHOULD move the vehicle as far off the ROADWAY as possible AND turn on the hazard warning lamps.

vague_terms.term: as far off the ROADWAY as possible

rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook advice; wording paraphrased. Texas law permits use of hazard lamps when a vehicle is stopped as a hazard.

rules.title: Two-way road: within 18 inches of the right curb
rules.when: stopping or parking on a two-way ROADWAY
rules.action: stop or park with the right-hand wheels parallel to and within 18 inches of the right-hand curb or edge of the ROADWAY
rules.unless: a local authority permits angle parking there by OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN stopping or parking on a two-way ROADWAY, the DRIVER MUST stop or park with the right-hand wheels parallel to and within 18 inches of the right-hand curb or edge of the ROADWAY, UNLESS a local authority permits angle parking there by OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE.
rules.note: Transportation Code 545.303(a); this also forbids parking facing against traffic on a two-way road.

rules.title: One-way road: within 18 inches of either curb
rules.when: stopping or parking on a one-way ROADWAY
rules.action: stop or park with the wheels on the curb side parallel to and within 18 inches of the right-hand or left-hand curb or edge of the ROADWAY
rules.unless: a local authority permits angle parking there by OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE prohibits parking on that side
rules.statement: WHEN stopping or parking on a one-way ROADWAY, the DRIVER MUST stop or park with the wheels on the curb side parallel to and within 18 inches of the right-hand or left-hand curb or edge of the ROADWAY, UNLESS a local authority permits angle parking there by OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE prohibits parking on that side.

rules.title: Angle parking where authorized
rules.when: a local authority has permitted angle parking on the ROADWAY AND it is indicated by OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE
rules.action: angle park the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN a local authority has permitted angle parking on the ROADWAY AND it is indicated by OFFICIAL TRAFFIC-CONTROL DEVICE, the DRIVER MAY ONLY angle park the vehicle.
rules.note: Transportation Code 545.303(c); angle parking on a state highway requires state approval. Read as: angle parking is allowed only where so authorized and marked.

rules.title: Signal and check before parallel parking
rules.when: about to parallel park in a space at the curb
rules.action: signal, check traffic behind, stop beside the vehicle ahead of the space, and back slowly into the space watching for traffic and pedestrians
rules.statement: WHEN about to parallel park in a space at the curb, the DRIVER SHOULD signal, check traffic behind, stop beside the vehicle ahead of the space, and back slowly into the space watching for traffic and pedestrians.
rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook procedure, summarized; exact steps and distances in the handbook may differ.

rules.title: Wheels to the curb on a grade
rules.when: leaving a motor vehicle UNATTENDED standing on a grade
rules.action: turn the front wheels to the curb or side of the HIGHWAY
rules.statement: WHEN leaving a motor vehicle UNATTENDED standing on a grade, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels to the curb or side of the HIGHWAY.

rules.title: Downhill: wheels toward the curb
rules.when: parking facing downhill
rules.action: turn the front wheels toward the curb or edge of the road AND set the parking brake
rules.statement: WHEN parking facing downhill, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels toward the curb or edge of the road AND set the parking brake.

rules.title: Uphill with curb: wheels away from curb
rules.when: parking facing uphill AND there is a curb
rules.action: turn the front wheels away from the curb and let the vehicle roll back until the rear of the front wheel rests against the curb AND set the parking brake
rules.statement: WHEN parking facing uphill AND there is a curb, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels away from the curb and let the vehicle roll back until the rear of the front wheel rests against the curb AND set the parking brake.

rules.title: Uphill without curb: wheels toward the edge
rules.when: parking facing uphill AND there is no curb
rules.action: turn the front wheels toward the edge of the road AND set the parking brake
rules.statement: WHEN parking facing uphill AND there is no curb, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels toward the edge of the road AND set the parking brake.

rules.title: Securing an unattended vehicle
rules.when: leaving a motor vehicle UNATTENDED
rules.action: stop the engine, lock the ignition, remove the key from the ignition, and effectively set the parking brake
rules.unless: the engine was started by a remote starter and the vehicle cannot be driven without the key
rules.statement: WHEN leaving a motor vehicle UNATTENDED, the DRIVER MUST stop the engine, lock the ignition, remove the key from the ignition, and effectively set the parking brake, UNLESS the engine was started by a remote starter and the vehicle cannot be driven without the key.
rules.note: Transportation Code 545.404. The remote-start exception is stated from memory; check its exact wording.

rules.title: Child left in vehicle
rules.when: a child younger than 7 years is in a motor vehicle AND no individual 14 years of age or older is in the vehicle with the child
rules.action: intentionally or knowingly leave the child in the vehicle for longer than 5 minutes
rules.statement: WHEN a child younger than 7 years is in a motor vehicle AND no individual 14 years of age or older is in the vehicle with the child, the person MUST NOT intentionally or knowingly leave the child in the vehicle for longer than 5 minutes.
rules.note: Texas Penal Code 22.10; more serious offenses may apply if the child is endangered.

rules.title: Opening doors safely
rules.when: in a stopped or parked vehicle
rules.action: open a door on the side available to moving traffic
rules.unless: it is reasonably safe to do so AND it can be done without interfering with the movement of other traffic
rules.statement: WHEN in a stopped or parked vehicle, the person MUST NOT open a door on the side available to moving traffic, UNLESS it is reasonably safe to do so AND it can be done without interfering with the movement of other traffic.

rules.title: Door open no longer than needed
rules.when: a door of a stopped or parked vehicle is on the side available to moving traffic
rules.action: leave the door open longer than necessary to load or unload passengers
rules.statement: WHEN a door of a stopped or parked vehicle is on the side available to moving traffic, the person MUST NOT leave the door open longer than necessary to load or unload passengers.

rules.title: Signal when pulling out
rules.when: starting from a parked position
rules.action: use the turn signal to indicate the intention to start
rules.statement: WHEN starting from a parked position, the DRIVER MUST use the turn signal to indicate the intention to start.

rules.title: Check and yield when pulling out
rules.when: pulling away from a parked position into traffic
rules.action: check mirrors and blind spots and yield the right-of-way to approaching traffic
rules.statement: WHEN pulling away from a parked position into traffic, the DRIVER MUST check mirrors and blind spots and yield the right-of-way to approaching traffic.
rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook; stated as instruction, wording paraphrased.

rules.title: Disabled parking spaces
rules.when: at a DISABLED PARKING SPACE
rules.action: PARK the vehicle in the space
rules.unless: the vehicle displays DISABLED PARKING IDENTIFICATION AND is being operated by or for the transportation of a person with a disability
rules.statement: WHEN at a DISABLED PARKING SPACE, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK the vehicle in the space, UNLESS the vehicle displays DISABLED PARKING IDENTIFICATION AND is being operated by or for the transportation of a person with a disability.
rules.penalty: Fine of $500 to $750 for a first offense, higher for repeat offenses; community service may be required.
rules.note: Transportation Code 681.011; fine amounts from memory.

rules.title: Do not block access aisles or ramps
rules.when: near an ACCESS AISLE, curb ramp, or other architectural improvement designed to aid persons with disabilities
rules.action: PARK the vehicle in the ACCESS AISLE or so that it blocks access to the ACCESS AISLE, curb ramp, or improvement
rules.statement: WHEN near an ACCESS AISLE, curb ramp, or other architectural improvement designed to aid persons with disabilities, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK the vehicle in the ACCESS AISLE or so that it blocks access to the ACCESS AISLE, curb ramp, or improvement.
rules.penalty: Fine of $500 to $750 for a first offense, higher for repeat offenses.
rules.note: Transportation Code 681.011; applies even to vehicles with DISABLED PARKING IDENTIFICATION.

rules.title: Display the placard
rules.when: parked in a DISABLED PARKING SPACE using a disabled parking placard
rules.action: display the placard hanging from the rearview mirror, or on the dashboard if there is no rearview mirror
rules.statement: WHEN parked in a DISABLED PARKING SPACE using a disabled parking placard, the DRIVER MUST display the placard hanging from the rearview mirror, or on the dashboard if there is no rearview mirror.
rules.note: Transportation Code 681; the law also says the placard is not to hang from the mirror while the vehicle is moving. Check exact wording.

rules.title: Meter fee exemption
rules.when: the vehicle displays DISABLED PARKING IDENTIFICATION AND is being operated by or for the transportation of a person with a disability AND is parked at a parking meter of a governmental unit
rules.action: park without paying the meter fee
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle displays DISABLED PARKING IDENTIFICATION AND is being operated by or for the transportation of a person with a disability AND is parked at a parking meter of a governmental unit, the DRIVER MAY park without paying the meter fee.
rules.note: Transportation Code 681.008; whether the exemption also covers time limits and government garages is uncertain and may vary locally.
